title: Matched label-free Earth surface texture set for the cinematic history globe
permissionStatement: Distributed under Attribution 4.0 International license: You may use, adapt, and share these textures for any purpose, even commercially.
projection: Equirectangular (WGS84 / plate carrée 2:1 aspect ratio, [-180°, 180°] longitude by [-90°, 90°] latitude, centered at 0° longitude, 0° latitude)
scope: Label-free global planetary surface albedo (day map), tangent-space relief normal map, and land/water specular mask for the homepage 3D globe.
limitations: Modern seasonal vegetation/albedo composite; not a historical land-cover or border reconstruction. National and event geography must come from the sourced GeoJSON layers (/maps/vietnam-tabletop.geojson, /maps/history-world-land.geojson) and event coordinate records.

assets.role: Primary label-free Earth day albedo texture (sRGB)
assets.creator: Solar System Scope / INOVE
transformations: Downscaled 2:1 from 8192×4096 to 4096×2048 using sharp 0.35.5 with Lanczos3 kernel to meet the ≤4096×2048 initial globe texture budget without keeping the 8K file in the repository.
Encoded as MozJPEG (quality 84, sRGB, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling). No geographic cropping, warping, or artificial label/border painting applied.

assets.role: Secondary tangent-space terrain normal map (linear RGB)
assets.creator: Solar System Scope / INOVE
transformations: Transcoded from upstream 2048×1024 TIFF (not natively decoded by browser HTMLImageElement / THREE.TextureLoader) to 2048×1024 JPEG using sharp 0.35.5.
Encoded as MozJPEG (quality 92, 4:4:4 full chroma resolution) to preserve X/Y tangent-space normal vector accuracy across mountain ranges without resolution or projection changes.

assets.role: Secondary land/water specular and roughness response mask (linear)
assets.creator: Solar System Scope / INOVE
transformations: Transcoded from upstream 2048×1024 TIFF to 2048×1024 MozJPEG (quality 85) using sharp 0.35.5 for browser TextureLoader compatibility.
No resolution, orientation, or coastline changes applied; matches the equirectangular UV grid of earth-day-4096x2048.jpg and earth-normal-2048x1024.jpg.
